Do NOT copy its composition or its props, and do NOT take the hero's look from it - the look comes ONLY from reference image 1.
Reference image 3 shows the result picture of this same event: copy its rough grey stone wall piece with the crack full of thin silver needles and its grey flagstone floor patch EXACTLY - it is the same spot. Take only the wall and the floor, NOT Feifei's pose (in the new picture she has just arrived and is crouching to look, not pulling needles out).
SCENE: SETTING on a small patch of grey flagstone floor: the SAME free-standing section of rough grey stone wall as in reference image 3 (a jagged grey rock wall piece standing on the floor, with one long vertical crack running down its front). SEVERAL thin silver needles (four or five) are stuck deep into that crack at different heights, their eyes pointing outward; two of them are clearly BENT at an angle. A short loose tuft of DARK-NAVY thread hangs caught on one of the needles, dangling down. On the grey flagstone floor at the foot of the wall lie a few small dried fish (five or six little brown-silver dried fish) scattered around. Feifei has just walked up to it: she crouches low on the floor in front of the wall, leaning forward, peering closely at the needles in the crack with a serious, searching look, both eyes wide the same way. Her RIGHT paw reaches out toward the dangling navy thread but has not touched it yet; her LEFT paw rests on her knee. Her paws hold nothing. Leave a clear transparent margin all around the wall and the floor patch.

NOTHING floats in mid-air. When a character holds something, the paw visibly wraps around it - the pads closed on the grip, the object sitting IN the paw, not hovering next to it. A sword that is being drawn or held has its hilt inside the closed paw.

The character's eyes look at the page.

Truly transparent RGBA background: no checkerboard drawing, no white box, no wall or sky filling the frame, no cast shadow outside the small floor patch. The whole scene is centred with a clear transparent margin on every side; nothing is cut off at the edges.

WORN GEAR: the purple bow on her ponytail, the black scarf at her throat and the row of gold needle tubes at her belt are attached to her - they never detach, never float beside her and never appear twice.
